description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs — intermittent, non-deterministic, environment-dependent, or performance regressions — where the first step is constructing a reliable feedback loop. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when the user says "diagnose this", when a bug resists a simple repro, is flaky or timing-dependent, or when a performance regression needs measurement. For deterministic failures with a clear signal (failing test, build break, readable stack trace), use debug instead.
